compilerCases.rationale: Explicit two one-layer unwraps preserve generic layers.
Assignment must not silently erase one Option layer.
One await returns Future<int>, not int. The suspends main entrypoint invokes use(), making two-layer extraction observable in a subsequent guest execution gate.
No Future<Future<T>> type canonicalization or implicit flattening.

Future.map returns Future<U> for callback result U; callback returning Future<int> produces Future<Future<int>> without implicit adoption. The suspends main entrypoint reaches both awaits and writes 40 when executed as guest; compiler admission alone does not execute it.
Future.map must not silently flatten a callback-returned Future layer or turn it into a Future<int>.
Sealed lexical state access requires a verified write effect and critical state loan.
Actor state reference must not escape handle_state or its lexical scope.
Await must be in a correctly checked suspending context.
Ordinary effect-unannotated function must not silently gain suspension.
Unique named call shape, once-only source-order binding.
Even distinct declaration arities cannot admit intersecting supplied-call shapes.
rt copy of statically Copy scalar duplicates the value, not the ownership slot.
rt copy of a move-only class must fail rather than manufacturing an alias.
Copy-safe scalar sharing creates no shared mutable storage or implicit actor transfer.
rt share does not grant a move-only object shared mutable aliases or Share proof.
Transferring a complete named owner is the supported path; its prior binding is unusable.
No path-aware partial-move state exists for fields; projected rt take cannot preserve unique ownership.
A lexical shared borrow reads the original owner without moving it.
Cannot mint a borrow from a binding whose ownership was transferred.
An exclusive lexical view is valid only from an owned mutable binding.
rt mut borrow cannot manufacture mutability from an immutable owner.
Channel<int> has compiler-verified payload Send and explicit synchronized shared handle authority.
The Channel handle can be copied, but Rc<int> payload is not Send and cannot imply Share.
SharedMutex<int> provides an explicitly synchronized shared capability with a Send-safe payload.
SelectSet is Copy in the Java ownership classifier, but has no Share proof; duplicating handle is not cross-domain alias authority.
Reading a Copy scalar member does not transfer the containing object's ownership.
Passing a move-only field by value cannot leave its containing field slot live without a path-aware partial-move ledger.
Reading an indexed Copy scalar is not a move of the array's element storage.
Returning an indexed move-only element by value must not silently retain a live array slot.
Ordinary conditional evaluation of Copy scalars is permitted; it does not claim to invalidate a selected owner.
A conditional expression cannot select a source owner for rt take without a tracked place invalidation, even when both branches are Copy.
An ordinary scalar cast may read a Copy member without moving the containing owner.
Casting a field expression must not launder an untracked source place into an rt take.
An ordinary assignment to a mutable scalar binding is not an ownership transfer.
rt take of an assignment expression cannot prove that the source storage place was invalidated.
Multiple immutable loans into the same resizable heap array can coexist in a lexical scope; resize after the loans end is legal.
A live projected loan protects the root allocation; an Array<T> grow may relocate storage, so mutation is forbidden.
Exclusive access can end before a subsequent immutable loan; allocation location does not change lexical exclusivity.
An exclusive loan and an overlapping read loan of the same heap owner must conflict.
Copyable scalar element retrieval is not a borrowed reference and cannot dangle after container retirement.
Returning a borrowed element of a locally owned heap array would outlive the owner.
Moving a uniquely owned array via its tracked root binding transfers the entire allocation.
Explicit take of an indexed heap slot is rejected until slot-level invalidation is tracked, including for Copy element types.

requirements: logical turn ticket retained during suspension
no raw state loan across await
gen* only executes on next pull
Future pipeline composition must be explicit and typed
